fields.label: Pool ID
fields.description: e.g. "commerce-pilot-tranche-1". One row per capital tranche — a later tranche is a new row, not an edit to this one, so the history of how the pool grew stays intact.

fields.label: Total Capital
fields.description: The tranche size, e.g. ₹10,000 for the first tranche. Never edited after creation — a top-up is a new Pool ID row.

fields.label: Deployed Capital
fields.description: Sum of capital currently committed to open, approved-and-executed proposals reading from this pool. Updated by Commerce Action Proposal, not edited by hand.

fields.label: Available Capital
fields.description: total_capital - deployed_capital. Computed on save; never set directly.

fields.label: Last Change Reason
fields.description: Why deployed_capital last moved — which proposal, or which reallocation from a proven-weak bet. Kept as free text here; full history lives on the Commerce Action Proposal rows themselves.
